definition: the official act of approving something
description: A young man in a blue t-shirt with a backpack stands in a crowded government office, clutching a black document folder to his chest and staring ahead, tense. Behind a glass counter a woman in a navy blazer leafs through a booklet, then lays an open passport on a sheet of holographic security stickers and presses one into it. She slides the finished passport back across the counter. The young man opens it, sees the page, and breaks into a huge grin while the people waiting behind him hold up cards marked 10.

en.question: What is the young man doing?

de.answer: Er sieht seinen Pass strahlend an.
de.question: Was macht der junge Mann?

es.answer: Le está sonriendo radiante a su pasaporte.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo el joven?

fr.answer: Il regarde son passeport d'un air radieux.
